context: Daichi attends Sho-young's school parents' day; pleasant teacher exchange.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 先生、授業、ありがとうございました。
lines.en: Thank you so much for everything you've done for Sho in class.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried Kansai cadence. Voice full and grateful — the earnest thanks of a parent who means every word. Slight bow in the voice on the opening. Lingering gratitude at the close.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 翔くん、ようやってますよ。
lines.style: Quiet pride held close. Steady, warm teacher-to-parent tone. Lands gently on each word. The kind of reassurance that comes from genuine observation, not routine.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 家でも、明るく話します。
lines.en: He comes home brighter every day. Talking more.
lines.style: Soft wonder underneath. The voice of a father noticing small, real changes. Unhurried pacing — letting each detail land. Genuine warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 友達も、たくさんできましたね。
lines.en: He's made quite a few friends now too.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Warm smile audible. Teacher-to-parent register, steady and encouraging. Light touch on the observation — offering it as a gift of good news.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'm truly grateful for everything you've taught him.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Deep gratitude with quiet sincerity. Slight weight on the opening syllable. The formal thanks of someone who knows what matters — measured, genuine, dignified.
